# 模拟卷 A：答案与评分要点

> 完成试卷后再打开。本卷存在合理等价答案；不要机械匹配范文。

## 听力稿（原创训练新闻）

### 校园节能计划

A university has announced a new energy-saving programme after electricity use rose by twelve percent last year. The programme will begin in January and cover all teaching buildings. Staff will replace old lights and ask students to turn off computers after use. According to the project manager, the main aim is to reduce waste rather than limit essential research. A student committee will collect feedback every month. The university plans to publish its first progress report at the end of the spring term.

### 城市阅读调查

A city library has released the results of a survey of eight hundred residents. The report shows that online reading is becoming more popular, but many older readers still prefer printed books. In response to the findings, the library will offer free digital skills classes twice a week. Volunteers will help participants search for reliable information and compare different sources. The director said that the project was intended to improve access to information. Its effects will be evaluated after six months.

## 一、新闻听力填空

### A-L1

1. twelve percent
2. teaching buildings
3. reduce waste
4. collect feedback
5. spring term

按听力稿原词填写；每空 2 分，搭配与词形均需正确。

### A-L2

6. eight hundred residents
7. printed books
8. twice a week
9. reliable information
10. six months

按听力稿原词填写；每空 2 分，搭配与词形均需正确。

## 二、句子纠错

### A-C1

Because the library closed early, we studied in the classroom.

从属连词 because 引导的片段需连接主句。

### A-C2

The survey was small, but the results were useful.

两个独立分句不能仅用逗号连接；也可用分号。

### A-C3

Each of the participants has completed the form.

主语是 each，谓语用单数。

### A-C4

The course improves reading, writing, and speaking.

并列成分保持动名词结构一致。

### A-C5

Although the task was difficult, the students finished it.

although 与 but 不在同一结构中重复连接。

### A-C6

Students should check their sources; it is important.

连续句需加边界，也可分成两句。

### A-C7

The researchers collected much useful information.

information 通常不可数，不能加 s。

### A-C8

When students use another writer's ideas, they must cite them.

students 为复数，回指代词应为 they；them 指 ideas。

### A-C9

Walking into the library, Li was surprised by the noise.

分词短语的逻辑主语应为走入图书馆的人。

### A-C10

The first study was limited. However, it raised an important question.

句首首字母大写，however 后加逗号。

## 三、段落改写与续写

### A-P1

Regular reading can improve academic writing in several ways. First, students notice how authors organise their arguments, which gives them models for their own work. In addition, they learn useful word combinations in meaningful contexts. Finally, reading helps them distinguish claims from supporting evidence. By paying attention to both language and reasoning, students can gradually make their own writing clearer and more persuasive.

删除 cafeteria 句（2分）；主题与支撑统一（2分）；连接与指代（2分）；语言（2分）。示例不是唯一答案。

### A-P2

Keeping a study diary can help postgraduate students use their time more effectively. A diary makes daily goals visible and allows students to compare their plans with what they actually achieve. For example, a student may discover that reading one difficult article takes two hours rather than thirty minutes. This information can guide a more realistic plan for the following week. Regular reflection therefore turns the diary into a practical tool for improving study habits.

主题展开（2分）；具体例子（2分）；逻辑与结句（2分）；语言（2分）。

## 四、Paraphrase

### A-R1

Students may concentrate better if they exercise regularly.

保留 can 的可能性，调整主语和条件结构。 原意1分、改写幅度1分、语言1分。

### A-R2

Higher transport costs led some students to choose accommodation close to the university.

因果从句变为名词短语；不应把 some 改成 all。 原意1分、改写幅度1分、语言1分。

### A-R3

According to the study, online feedback was helpful but could not substitute for discussion in person.

保留信息来源与让步关系。 原意1分、改写幅度1分、语言1分。

## 五、Summary

### A-S1

A university library offered workshops that taught students to evaluate online sources by checking authorship, dates and evidence. Participants later explained their source choices more clearly. However, the voluntary sample and absence of a comparison group limited the conclusions, so the library plans further testing.

主旨3分；关键方法/结果3分；限制或条件2分；简洁与语言2分。例文可有其他表达。

## 六、短文写作

### A-E1

Universities should require first-year postgraduate students to take an academic writing course because clear writing is essential to research. Such a course can support both effective communication and responsible scholarship.

First, students need to learn how to organise complex ideas. A strong topic sentence and relevant evidence help readers follow an argument. For example, a short assignment on paragraph structure can reveal weaknesses that are difficult to notice in a full research paper. Second, a writing course can teach students to paraphrase accurately and acknowledge their sources. These skills help them explain existing research without copying its language.

Some students may argue that a compulsory course takes time away from their experiments. This concern is reasonable, especially when schedules are already crowded. However, a practical course can use students' own research topics, making the work directly relevant to their projects.

In conclusion, an academic writing course offers useful preparation for postgraduate research. If it includes focused practice and constructive feedback, the time invested can improve the quality of students' later work.

内容与任务完成7分；结构与支撑7分；语言准确与多样性7分；衔接、拼写和标点4分。
